source.title: MBS Statistical Yearbook 2024, Table 11.6: Selected Vehicles According to Registration, 2018 end

scope.official_observation: Vehicle counts are officially published only for Male, Hulhumale, Addu and Other atolls.
scope.island_table: Male and Hulhumale retain official locality counts. Addu and Other atolls are allocated across populated islands using category-specific population, land-area and smaller-island heuristics.
scope.not_claimed: The estimated island rows are not an island-level vehicle registry and must not be described as observed registration records.
scope.zero_population_islands: Excluded from the allocation because the population-proportional method has no defensible denominator; resort, industrial and uninhabited island registrations remain unknown.

allocation_model.motor_cycle_and_battery_scooter: 0.65 population share + 0.35 inverse-square-root-land-area share; smaller islands receive relatively more two-wheelers
allocation_model.car_and_jeep: 0.75 population share + 0.25 land-area share; larger islands receive relatively more cars/jeeps
allocation_model.bus_pick_up_lorry_van_other: 0.55 population share + 0.45 land-area share; larger islands receive relatively more heavy/service vehicles
allocation_model.rounding: largest remainder per vehicle category and source locality
allocation_model.status: heuristic planning estimate, not a measured island registry
